name: light_sleeper
revision: r2 (2026-11-10): the critic's 7 must-fixes and the should-fixes applied; see reviews/r2-selfcheck.md
caption: why is my whole village carpeted 😶
logline: A boy in a village where every inch is carpeted, the bell is wrapped in wool and the well wears a wool lid wants everyone to hear one song, so he puts a jukebox on the well.
question: why tf is the whole village covered in carpet?
premise: Every road, stair and doghouse in the boy's village is carpeted, 300 sheep are sheared every morning, the bell is boxed in wool and the well wears a white wool lid. Mom says 'walk soft, the ground's a light sleeper'. Once he pulled the wool off the well and the bottom of the well screamed; Mom said it was a fox. Then a skeleton, shooting at him, hits a creeper, and he gets a music disc in a village where nobody has ever heard a song.
twist: The carpet is silence (vanilla: walking on wool and carpet makes no vibration, and wool blocks stop vibrations). The village sits on an ancient city and the bottom of the well is a sculk shrieker. Tonight he pulls the lid off again because wells echo, puts a jukebox on the well, puts the disc in, and steps off the carpet onto the well's bare stone rim to dance: four shrieks, the Darkness pulsing ('like a real party'), and the warden rises out of the square. He was obliterated by a sonically-charged shriek.

N.on_screen: pov (the hand, never his face); Milo as a kid; seen from outside only small and from behind (S07, S12's crane start, S13's shoulder, S16), default Steve skin (owner: the hero stays Steve)
N.audition: Before locking the voice, take L01, L07 and L15 three ways: the library `child` (Leda, lifted 2 semitones), the library `milo` (Achird, directed younger and hushed) and Iapetus (the r1 pick). Pick the one that whispers L01 without going breathy and still lifts on L14-L15; record the pick here. Never override the library profile: the whisper lives in the request's scene sentence and the line notes.

Mom.on_screen: villager, plains farmer (straw hat), no name tag

requests.direction: A village where everyone speaks in a hush. A young boy tells a friend a secret story, hushed and close; his mother speaks softly, like a lullaby. Nobody ever shouts.
The same hushed village, tonight. The boy is excited and hushed at first, then forgets to keep his voice down; his mother speaks in a terrified hush.

lines.text: My village / is covered in / NINE THOUSAND / CARPETS.
lines.say: My village is covered in... nine thousand carpets.
lines.direction: hushed and close to the mic, as if the floor could hear; a held breath before the number

lines.text: The ROADS. / The STAIRS. / Even the DOGHOUSE.
lines.direction: a hushed list, each item a little more amazed, a small smile on the last

lines.text: We keep / THREE HUNDRED / sheep. / We shear them / every MORNING.
lines.direction: hushed and matter-of-fact, this is normal to him

lines.text: Our BELL / is wrapped / in WOOL. / I've never / HEARD it.
lines.direction: hushed wonder; a small pause before the last phrase

lines.text: Walk SOFT, / sweetie. / The ground's / a light SLEEPER.
lines.say: Walk soft, sweetie. <short pause> The ground's a light sleeper.
lines.direction: lullaby-warm and hushed, smiling; something careful under it; the last word held a moment

lines.text: Once, / I pulled / the WOOL / off the WELL.
lines.say: Once... I pulled the wool off the well.
lines.direction: a little guilty, still hushed, a beat after the first word

lines.text: The bottom / of the well / SCREAMED.
lines.say: The bottom of the well... screamed.
lines.direction: the hush drops lower; a breath held before the last word

lines.text: Mom held me / in the DARK. / She said / it was / a FOX.
Then a skeleton / shot a CREEPER / by the farm. / It dropped / a music DISC.
lines.direction: brightening and speeding up, excited, the best news of his life, still hushed

lines.text: Nobody here / has ever heard / a SONG.
lines.direction: slow and longing; this is the want

lines.text: So tonight, / I put / a JUKEBOX / on the WELL. / Wells ECHO.
lines.say: So tonight... I put a jukebox on the well. <short pause> Wells echo.
lines.direction: a held breath before he starts; determined, a little proud; the last two words a clever secret

lines.text: The fox / screamed AGAIN. / I didn't CARE.
lines.direction: giddy and defiant, a grin in it, the hush slipping
a breathless hush, terrified, still trying to sound gentle; long gaps between the words

lines.text: The music / made the lights / go DARK. / Like a / real PARTY.
lines.direction: rising out of the hush into his full voice for the first time, delighted and wonder-struck, not hearing her at all
out loud now, almost laughing, the happiest he has ever sounded, trailing off at the end
